description: This file defines the TimezoneName validation rule class used within the OrangeHRM system. It checks whether a given string is a valid timezone using PHP's DateTimeZone class.

classes.name: TimezoneName
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies if a given input string is a valid timezone name.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the input is a string and a valid timezone name.

methods.name: isValidTimezone
methods.description: Attempts to create a DateTimeZone object with the provided timezone name; returns true if successful, false if an exception is thrown.
